records.english: Common Commands{LB}Save/load, quit the game,{LB}and change options.{LB}{PAD}
At-Sea Data{LB}Shows position, supplies,{LB}sailors, and fatigue.{LB}{PAD}
Latitude/Longitude{LB}Shows your position.{LB}A skilled Surveyor is required.{LB}{PAD}
Food/Water{LB}Remaining barrels for the fleet.{LB}At zero, sailor fatigue rises sharply.{LB}{PAD}
Sailors{LB}Total sailors in the fleet.{LB}At zero, the game ends.{LB}{PAD}
Vitality{LB}Physical toughness.{LB}Higher values make defeat less likely.{LB}{PAD}
Agility{LB}Speed and dexterity.{LB}Higher values help in combat.{LB}{PAD}
Spirit{LB}Strength of will.{LB}Higher values help you stay calm in danger.{LB}{PAD}
Luck{LB}How fortunate you are.{LB}Higher values help avoid danger.{LB}{PAD}
Level{LB}Your sailing level.{LB}It rises through sailing experience.{LB}{PAD}
Favorability{LB}Relationship with a faction.{LB}Higher is friendlier.{LB}{PAD}
